headline: On October 9, 1986: The Phantom of the Opera opens
instagramCaption:
Andrew Lloyd Webber’s musical masterpiece premiered at London’s Her Majesty’s Theatre in 1986. Inspired by Gaston Leroux’s 1910 novel, the show tells the tragic story of soprano Christine Daaé and a disfigured genius beneath the Paris Opera House. With lyrics by Charles Hart and Richard Stilgoe, it quickly became the second longest-running musical in London history. Its enduring legacy continues to captivate audiences decades later.
